title: Tensorization of two-function hypercontractivity
statement:
Fix exponents $p, q \ge 1$ and a noise parameter $\rho$ with $0 \le \rho \le 1$, and
write $T_\rho$ for the associated noise operator. Suppose the two-function bound
\[
\langle f, T_\rho g\rangle \;\le\;
\bigl(\E[\abs{f}^p]\bigr)^{1/p}\,\bigl(\E[\abs{g}^q]\bigr)^{1/q}
\]
holds for every pair of Boolean functions $f, g \colon \{0,1\}^1 \to \bbr$ on the
one-dimensional cube. Then, for every $n$, the same inequality holds for every pair of
Boolean functions $f, g \colon \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$. For $d\in\mathbb N$, $h:\{0,1\}^d\to\bbr$, and $\tau\in\bbr$, the spectral noise operator is $T_\tau h(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq[d]}\tau^{|S|}\widehat h(S)\chi_S(x)$, where $\chi_S(x)=(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}x_i}$ and $\widehat h(S)=\E[h\chi_S]$ under the uniform measure.
hypotheses_covered: base case: the two-function bound holds for all f, g on the 1-dimensional cube
replaced:
Let $p, q \ge 1$ and $0 \le \rho \le 1$. If
$\inn{f, T_\rho g} \le (\E[\abs{f}^p])^{1/p}(\E[\abs{g}^q])^{1/q}$ holds for all
$f, g : \mathrm{BoolCube}\,1 \to \bbr$, then the same bound holds for all $n$ and all
$f, g : \mathrm{BoolCube}\,n \to \bbr$.
